$schema_note: Flat, row-per-CVar table for the feeding/distraction mechanic (docs/design/feeding-distraction.md). Unlike unit-types.json/squads.json (nested config), this is deliberately a flat DataTable shape -- one row per tuning dial, single typed Value column -- per task-053's explicit 'must import cleanly as a UE DataTable' requirement. Bool/int dials are stored as float (0/1 or integer-valued) so every row shares one struct shape.
note: All values are PROTOTYPE DIALS, unmeasured against the real Mass sim (spec's density check, §8, used a scratch Fermi model, not an engine run). Each row mirrors a Swarm.Feeding.* CVar task-054 should register.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.Enabled
rows.Description: Master on/off. Lets task-054 reproduce a zero-input A/B baseline with and without feeding, same measurement pattern as docs/GATE1-FUN-PROTOTYPE.md section 3.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.MaxPerCorpse
rows.Description: Hard cap on the killer set (spec section 2/4): at most this many simultaneous killers of one victim enter feeding. Owner-specified cap.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.ChompRate
rows.Description: Seconds of feed duration per point of the killed unit's MaxHP (spec section 3). Proxy for armor until task-002 lands the real stat -- see the spec's task-002 handoff note.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.MinDuration
rows.Description: Floor on feed duration, seconds. Keeps even a fodder kill legible instead of a single-frame flicker.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.MaxDuration
rows.Description: Ceiling on feed duration, seconds. Stops a future high-MaxHP titan/elite kill from freezing a unit absurdly long.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.RetinueFeedChance
rows.Description: Per-killer-set-member chance a RETINUE killer actually enters feeding. Load-bearing anti-stall dial -- spec section 8 measures the unthrottled retinue duty cycle at ~31% of the whole army (scale-invariant, not just a wave-3 artifact) and this dial is what brings it down to ~11%.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.BroodFeedChance
rows.Description: Per-killer-set-member chance a BROOD killer actually enters feeding. Kept high on purpose -- the 700-brood wave-3 pool absorbs it (spec section 8 measures under 17% of the pool feeding even in the worst case tested), and it should read often as the tone/horror beat (spec section 7).

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.Cooldown
rows.Description: Seconds after a completed feed before that unit can be selected into another killer set. Secondary valve against one high-kill-rate unit chain-feeding back to back at short feed durations.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.HealFraction
rows.Description: Fraction of the feeder's own MaxHP restored on UNINTERRUPTED completion only (spec section 6). A feeder killed mid-feed gets nothing -- keeps the payoff incidental to the (involuntary) act rather than a chosen reward.

rows.Name: Swarm.Feeding.HeroExempt
rows.Description: The hero never enters feeding, regardless of kills. Exposed as a CVar per house convention but should stay 1 -- this is a GDD section 4 hero-relevance guardrail, not a balance knob.
